references.text: Both verses confirm the brothers' honesty and their awareness that they returned the money that had been placed back, which forms the basis of their defense against the theft accusation.
The verse in 43:21 describes the actual event with the silver referred to in 44:8, and together they show the brothers' consistent honesty throughout the entire process.
The connection shows a dramatic development in the brothers' understanding of the event: from fear that the silver was a trap to using the same fact as proof of their innocence.
The verse in 43:12 is the direct instruction that the brothers refer to in 44:8 when they confirm that they have carried out the mission to return the money.
